name: What preparation is needed on my part to get an AI-powered market analysis for my property?

mainEntity.name: What preparation is needed on my part to get an AI-powered market analysis for my property?

acceptedAnswer.text: To get an AI-powered market analysis for your property, you'll need to provide basic property details such as its address, property type, number of bedrooms/bathrooms, and square footage. Any recent upgrades, unique features, or known issues should also be disclosed to ensure the AI's assessment is as accurate as possible. Kelby Contreras will guide you through this process, ensuring all relevant information is captured to generate the most comprehensive analysis.
acceptedAnswer.description: To get an AI market analysis, provide basic property details like address, type, size, and any recent upgrades or unique features.
